text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
McQueen was telling me that she wishes
to visit
the new makeup store on our
next day off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She made it sound like you and I would
be joining
her, but... Did you know
about this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What? No, that's news to me. A makeup
store,
huh... Those places are awfully...
girly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you and McQueen will find
products that
suit you, but... I don't
think makeup suits me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on. What are you talking
about,
Dober? You're adorable! You'd
look great with
makeup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I mean... I don't personally think I'm
ready for
makeup... But I'd still like to
take a look.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'd feel a lot more comfortable with you
there...
But if you don't want to...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A-all right. But you better not try to get
out of
this little shopping trip later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I won't! And don't worry... We've
got this!
